facts.fact: The FY2026/27 original estimates (Programme Based Budget, Vote 1122) appropriate KES 12,763,784,217 to the State Department for ICT and Digital Economy; the vote was restructured, with cyber and data protection given their own programme.
facts.system: Vote 1122 State Department for ICT and Digital Economy, FY2026/27

facts.fact: The budget-day digital superhighway and creative economy package fell to KSh 8.6bn for FY2026/27, the second consecutive cut after KSh 16.3bn and KSh 12.7bn; KSh 4.3bn of it is the World Bank-backed KDEAP.
facts.system: Digital superhighway and creative economy package, FY2026/27
